description: Open CASCADE's own STEP of blend/bead-root-fillet (a toroidal bead on a disc, both roots filleted at r 0.2), read as a part: its blend is a B-spline surface of degree 2 by 14 walked along each root, and its contacts B-spline curves of degree 14. Arris's reader fits the outer contact's pcurve on that surface for about four minutes in a release build and refuses it: no pcurve, #21 on face #149, 'fit: cannot fit: the normal equations are singular' (plans/c6-blend-pairs step 6, found by the read-back stage; blend/cut-torus-rims-fillet's file is refused the same way). The desired assertion: it reads, quickly, and matches Open CASCADE's reading.
